newsitem.title: USA: Dove gets $3 mln equity investment - paper.
newsitem.headline: Dove gets $3 mln equity investment - paper.

text.p: A newly formed partnership of former entertainment executives has made a $3 million equity investment in newly issued shares of Dove Entertainment Inc common stock, the Daily Variety reported Wednesday.
The publication said the partnership, called Media Equities International, gets about 20 percent of Dove stock, or 1.2 million shares, with about 6.5 million shares outstanding.
The group also will receive a warrant giving it the option to increase its stake at increasing levels above the current market price, the paper said.
Dove shares closed Tuesday down 1/4 at 2-1/4.
Los Angeles-based Dove Entertainment is run by President and Chief Executive Michael Viner and his wife, Deborah Raffin.
